comingLast.roast: finished on 18 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
at 1.2 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
5 to play, 1 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
1 above the drop - hole by hole, point by point, beer by beer
1 point from the wooden end of the presentation
the buffer reads 2 - his group reads it aloud each tee
2 clear of the worst seat in the house
4 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
5 above Elliott and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
6 above Elliott and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
